subject.title: feat: add jsonl support to memory indexer

question: Should builtin memorySearch.extraPaths ingest arbitrary JSONL raw message logs, or should raw JSONL recall stay outside the builtin Markdown/multimodal memory path?
rationale: Current code and docs intentionally center builtin extraPaths on Markdown plus narrow multimodal/session surfaces, while raw log ingestion broadens sensitive-data visibility and may be better owned by QMD, a converter, or a plugin/API design.

options.title: Document Supported Alternative
options.body: Keep builtin memory Markdown/multimodal-only and document QMD, session-memory export, converter, or plugin-owned workflows for raw JSONL recall.

options.title: Add Native Builtin JSONL
options.body: Implement JSONL as a first-class builtin memory format with line-aware chunking, watcher and memory_get support, tests, docs, and privacy guardrails.

options.title: Defer For Plugin/API Design
options.body: Keep this open until maintainers decide whether a plugin or memory API extension should own arbitrary raw-log ingestion.

recommendation.title: Document Supported Alternative
recommendation.body: Keep builtin memory Markdown/multimodal-only and document QMD, session-memory export, converter, or plugin-owned workflows for raw JSONL recall.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already provided maintainer-side context on this issue and has recent history in the memory host/runtime ownership boundary.
